about: Operation cases of the res/graph store contract. Each case runs its steps in order against a new, empty store opened with the case's options; a durable case runs only on a durable store. See README.md for the step vocabulary.

cases.name: an upsert advances the revision and keeps created_at
an edge upsert keeps created_at and records provenance
a record that does not exist is not found
a repeated ID in one transaction keeps the last record
apply needs a registered namespace
a transaction is atomic and an edge cannot dangle
deleting a vertex with incident edges needs delete_incident_edges
deleting the incident edges first lets the vertex go
deleting a record that does not exist is not found
records can be deleted and replaced in one transaction
an edge to a vertex deleted in the same transaction dangles
an idempotency key replays its commit and rejects a different transaction
idempotency keys are scoped to a namespace
expected_revision must match the namespace revision
idempotency records expire with their commit
namespaces are isolated and cursors are global
a snapshot of an unknown namespace is empty
names follow the naming rule
secret-like keys and markers are refused
a string attribute is at most 4096 bytes
a transaction holds at most max_transaction_records records
a record's labels and attributes are at most max_record_bytes
reads need a positive limit within max_results
a snapshot holds at most max_snapshot_records records
queries filter and order by ID
traversal is breadth first along outgoing edges with bounds
compacted history needs a new snapshot
the byte bound keeps the latest commit
a failed transaction advances nothing
a watch replays retained changes within its buffer
a declarative schema limits kinds, relationships and endpoints
a schema's names are under its namespace

a durable store keeps records, schemas, history and idempotency across reopen
a durable store keeps idempotency records across reopen
